name: CriticalGK2.extendedPair_eq_zero_of_mem_scalarExtension
statement:
theorem extendedPair_eq_zero_of_mem_scalarExtension
    (D : Submodule F X) (z : X ⊗[F] C)
    (hz : z ∈ scalarExtension D) (φ : Module.Dual F X)
    (hφ : φ ∈ D.dualAnnihilator) : extendedPair φ z = 0

name: CriticalGK2.extendedPair_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem extendedPair_tmul (φ : Module.Dual F X) (x : X) (c : C) :
    extendedPair φ (x ⊗ₜ[F] c) = φ x • c

name: CriticalGK2.contractFirst_inclusion
statement:
theorem contractFirst_inclusion (W : Submodule F Z) (φ : Module.Dual F X)
    (w : (X ⊗[F] Y) ⊗[F] W) :
    contractFirst φ (W.subtype.lTensor (X ⊗[F] Y) w) =
      W.subtype.lTensor Y (contractFirst φ w)

name: CriticalGK2.contractFirst_mem_right_support
statement:
theorem contractFirst_mem_right_support (W : Submodule F Z)
    (φ : Module.Dual F X) (z : (X ⊗[F] Y) ⊗[F] Z)
    (hz : z ∈ LinearMap.range (W.subtype.lTensor (X ⊗[F] Y))) :
    contractFirst φ z ∈ LinearMap.range (W.subtype.lTensor Y)

name: CriticalGK2.contractFirst_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem contractFirst_tmul (φ : Module.Dual F X) (x : X) (y : Y) (z : Z) :
    contractFirst φ ((x ⊗ₜ[F] y) ⊗ₜ[F] z) = φ x • (y ⊗ₜ[F] z)

name: CriticalGK2.contractLast_inclusion
statement:
theorem contractLast_inclusion (W : Submodule F X) (φ : Module.Dual F Z)
    (w : W ⊗[F] (Y ⊗[F] Z)) :
    contractLast φ (W.subtype.rTensor (Y ⊗[F] Z) w) =
      W.subtype.rTensor Y (contractLast φ w)

name: CriticalGK2.contractLast_mem_left_support
statement:
theorem contractLast_mem_left_support (W : Submodule F X)
    (φ : Module.Dual F Z) (z : X ⊗[F] (Y ⊗[F] Z))
    (hz : z ∈ LinearMap.range (W.subtype.rTensor (Y ⊗[F] Z))) :
    contractLast φ z ∈ LinearMap.range (W.subtype.rTensor Y)

name: CriticalGK2.contractLast_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem contractLast_tmul (φ : Module.Dual F Z) (x : X) (y : Y) (z : Z) :
    contractLast φ (x ⊗ₜ[F] (y ⊗ₜ[F] z)) = φ z • (x ⊗ₜ[F] y)

name: CriticalGK2.contractRight_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem contractRight_tmul (φ : Module.Dual F Y) (x : X) (y : Y) :
    contractRight φ (x ⊗ₜ[F] y) = φ y • x

name: CriticalGK2.evaluatePair_eq_zero_of_left_support
statement:
theorem evaluatePair_eq_zero_of_left_support
    (W : Submodule F X) (f : X →ₗ[F] A) (g : Y →ₗ[F] B)
    (mul : A →ₗ[F] B →ₗ[F] T) (hW : W ≤ LinearMap.ker f)
    (z : X ⊗[F] Y) (hz : z ∈ LinearMap.range (W.subtype.rTensor Y)) :
    evaluatePair f g mul z = 0

name: CriticalGK2.evaluatePair_eq_zero_of_right_support
statement:
theorem evaluatePair_eq_zero_of_right_support
    (W : Submodule F Y) (f : X →ₗ[F] A) (g : Y →ₗ[F] B)
    (mul : A →ₗ[F] B →ₗ[F] T) (hW : W ≤ LinearMap.ker g)
    (z : X ⊗[F] Y) (hz : z ∈ LinearMap.range (W.subtype.lTensor X)) :
    evaluatePair f g mul z = 0

name: CriticalGK2.evaluatePair_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem evaluatePair_tmul (f : X →ₗ[F] A) (g : Y →ₗ[F] B)
    (mul : A →ₗ[F] B →ₗ[F] T) (x : X) (y : Y) :
    evaluatePair f g mul (x ⊗ₜ[F] y) = mul (f x) (g y)

name: CriticalGK2.fixed_right_tensor_injective

name: CriticalGK2.fullPrefixContractionSupport_le

theorem fullPrefixContractionSupport_le (W : Submodule F X)

    fullPrefixContractionSupport S ≤ LinearMap.range (W.subtype.rTensor Y)

name: CriticalGK2.fullPrefixContractionSupport_le_evaluation_kernel
statement:
theorem fullPrefixContractionSupport_le_evaluation_kernel
    (W : Submodule F X) (f : X →ₗ[F] A) (g : Y →ₗ[F] B)
    (mul : A →ₗ[F] B →ₗ[F] T) (hW : W ≤ LinearMap.ker f)
    (S : Submodule F (X ⊗[F] (Y ⊗[F] Z)))
    (hS : S ≤ LinearMap.range (W.subtype.rTensor (Y ⊗[F] Z))) :
    fullPrefixContractionSupport S ≤ LinearMap.ker (evaluatePair f g mul)

name: CriticalGK2.fullSuffixContractionSupport_le
statement:
theorem fullSuffixContractionSupport_le (W : Submodule F Z)
    (S : Submodule F ((X ⊗[F] Y) ⊗[F] Z))
    (hS : S ≤ LinearMap.range (W.subtype.lTensor (X ⊗[F] Y))) :
    fullSuffixContractionSupport S ≤ LinearMap.range (W.subtype.lTensor Y)

name: CriticalGK2.fullSuffixContractionSupport_le_evaluation_kernel
statement:
theorem fullSuffixContractionSupport_le_evaluation_kernel
    (W : Submodule F Z) (f : Y →ₗ[F] A) (g : Z →ₗ[F] B)
    (mul : A →ₗ[F] B →ₗ[F] T) (hW : W ≤ LinearMap.ker g)
    (S : Submodule F ((X ⊗[F] Y) ⊗[F] Z))
    (hS : S ≤ LinearMap.range (W.subtype.lTensor (X ⊗[F] Y))) :

name: CriticalGK2.long_prefix_contraction_evaluation_eq_zero
statement:
theorem long_prefix_contraction_evaluation_eq_zero
    (W : Submodule F X) (f : X →ₗ[F] A) (g : Y →ₗ[F] B)
    (mul : A →ₗ[F] B →ₗ[F] T) (hW : W ≤ LinearMap.ker f)
    (φ : Module.Dual F Z) (z : X ⊗[F] (Y ⊗[F] Z))
    (hz : z ∈ LinearMap.range (W.subtype.rTensor (Y ⊗[F] Z))) :
    evaluatePair f g mul (contractLast φ z) = 0

name: CriticalGK2.long_suffix_contraction_evaluation_eq_zero
statement:
theorem long_suffix_contraction_evaluation_eq_zero
    (W : Submodule F Z) (f : Y →ₗ[F] A) (g : Z →ₗ[F] B)
    (mul : A →ₗ[F] B →ₗ[F] T) (hW : W ≤ LinearMap.ker g)
    (φ : Module.Dual F X) (z : (X ⊗[F] Y) ⊗[F] Z)
    (hz : z ∈ LinearMap.range (W.subtype.lTensor (X ⊗[F] Y))) :
    evaluatePair f g mul (contractFirst φ z) = 0

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.fixedRightMap_apply

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.leftFlattening_append_apply
statement:
theorem leftFlattening_append_apply (t : X ⊗[F] Y) (z : Z)
    (eta : Module.Dual F (Y ⊗[F] Z)) :
    leftFlattening (TensorProduct.assoc F X Y Z (t ⊗ₜ[F] z)) eta =
      leftFlattening t (specializeRight z eta)

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.leftFlattening_append_range
statement:
theorem leftFlattening_append_range (t : X ⊗[F] Y) (z : Z) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    LinearMap.range (leftFlattening (TensorProduct.assoc F X Y Z (t ⊗ₜ[F] z))) =
      LinearMap.range (leftFlattening t)

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.leftFlattening_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem leftFlattening_apply (t : X ⊗[F] Y) (eta : Module.Dual F Y) :
    leftFlattening t eta = contractRight eta t

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.leftFlattening_leftEquiv_range
statement:
theorem leftFlattening_leftEquiv_range {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A]
    (e : X ≃ₗ[F] A) (t : X ⊗[F] Y) :
    LinearMap.range (leftFlattening (e.rTensor Y t)) =
      (LinearMap.range (leftFlattening t)).map e.toLinearMap

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.leftFlattening_prepend_apply
statement:
theorem leftFlattening_prepend_apply (z : Z) (t : X ⊗[F] Y)
    (eta : Module.Dual F Y) :
    leftFlattening ((TensorProduct.assoc F Z X Y).symm (z ⊗ₜ[F] t)) eta =
      z ⊗ₜ[F] leftFlattening t eta

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.leftFlattening_prepend_range
statement:
theorem leftFlattening_prepend_range (z : Z) (t : X ⊗[F] Y) :
    LinearMap.range
        (leftFlattening ((TensorProduct.assoc F Z X Y).symm (z ⊗ₜ[F] t))) =
      (LinearMap.range (leftFlattening t)).map (TensorProduct.mk F Z X z)

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.leftFlattening_rightEquiv_range
statement:
theorem leftFlattening_rightEquiv_range {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A]
    (e : Y ≃ₗ[F] A) (t : X ⊗[F] Y) :
    LinearMap.range (leftFlattening (e.lTensor X t)) =
      LinearMap.range (leftFlattening t)

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.rightFlattening_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem rightFlattening_apply (t : X ⊗[F] Y) (phi : Module.Dual F X) :

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.rightFlattening_finrank_eq_left

theorem rightFlattening_finrank_eq_left [FiniteDimensional F X] [FiniteDimensional F Y]

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.specializeRight_apply
statement:
@[simp] theorem specializeRight_apply (z : Z)

theorem tensorCutRank_leftEquiv {A : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A]

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.tensorCutRank_rightEquiv

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.extendedPair_append
statement:
theorem extendedPair_append (phi : Module.Dual F X) (t : X ⊗[F] Y) (z : Z) :

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.freeTailTensorSpace_prefixSupport
statement:
theorem freeTailTensorSpace_prefixSupport (t : X ⊗[F] Y) (z0 : Z) (hz0 : z0 ≠ 0) :

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.freeTailTensorSpace_prefixSupport_finrank
statement:
theorem freeTailTensorSpace_prefixSupport_finrank (t : X ⊗[F] Y)

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.freeTailTensorSpace_suffixSupport
statement:
theorem freeTailTensorSpace_suffixSupport (t : X ⊗[F] Y) :

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.freeTailTensorSpace_suffixSupport_finrank
statement:
theorem freeTailTensorSpace_suffixSupport_finrank [FiniteDimensional F X]
    [FiniteDimensional F Y] [FiniteDimensional F Z] (t : X ⊗[F] Y) :
    Module.finrank F (tensorSuffixSupport (freeTailTensorSpace (Z := Z) t)) =
      tensorCutRank t * Module.finrank F Z

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.scalarExtension_finrank

theorem scalarExtension_finrank {A B : Type*} [AddCommGroup A] [Module F A]

    Module.finrank F (scalarExtension (C := B) S) =
      Module.finrank F S * Module.finrank F B

    (matrixNil : ∀ r : ℕ, 0 < r → ∀ M : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) (A ⊗[F] K),

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.scalarTensorComm_map_mul
statement:
theorem scalarTensorComm_map_mul (x y : A ⊗[F] K) :
    TensorProduct.comm F A K (x * y) =
      TensorProduct.comm F A K x * TensorProduct.comm F A K y

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.scalarTensorComm_matrix_positivePower
statement:
theorem scalarTensorComm_matrix_positivePower (r : ℕ)
    (M : Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) (A ⊗[F] K)) (e : ℕ) :
    (CriticalGK2.positivePower M e).map (scalarTensorComm F K A) =
      CriticalGK2.positivePower (M.map (scalarTensorComm F K A)) e

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.scalarTensorComm_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem scalarTensorComm_tmul (a : A) (c : K) :
    scalarTensorComm F K A (a ⊗ₜ[F] c) = c ⊗ₜ[F] a

name: CriticalGK2.exists_stemWord_of_length
statement:
theorem exists_stemWord_of_length (n : ℕ) (w : FreeMonoid Bool) (hw : w.length = n) :
    ∃ a : StemWord n, FreeMonoid.ofList (List.ofFn a) = w

name: CriticalGK2.Automaton.consumePrefix_append
statement:
@[simp]
theorem consumePrefix_append (p t : List Bool) :
    consumePrefix p (p ++ t) = some t

name: CriticalGK2.Automaton.consumePrefix_eq_some_iff
statement:
theorem consumePrefix_eq_some_iff (p w t : List Bool) :
    consumePrefix p w = some t ↔ w = p ++ t

name: CriticalGK2.Automaton.consumePrefix_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem consumePrefix_nil (w : List Bool) : consumePrefix [] w = some w

name: CriticalGK2.Automaton.consumePrefix_none_no_append
statement:
theorem consumePrefix_none_no_append (p w : List Bool)
    (h : consumePrefix p w = none) : ¬ ∃ t, w = p ++ t

name: CriticalGK2.Automaton.length_le_of_consumePrefix_eq_some
statement:
theorem length_le_of_consumePrefix_eq_some (p w t : List Bool)
    (h : consumePrefix p w = some t) : t.length ≤ w.length

name: CriticalGK2.Automaton.afterConsume_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem afterConsume_nil {R : Type*} [Zero R] (w : List Bool) (f : List Bool → R) :
    afterConsume [] w f = f w

name: CriticalGK2.Automaton.afterConsume_of_none
statement:
theorem afterConsume_of_none {R : Type*} [Zero R] (p w : List Bool)
    (h : consumePrefix p w = none) (f : List Bool → R) :
    afterConsume p w f = 0

name: CriticalGK2.Automaton.afterConsume_of_some
statement:
theorem afterConsume_of_some {R : Type*} [Zero R] (p w t : List Bool)
    (h : consumePrefix p w = some t) (f : List Bool → R) :
    afterConsume p w f = f t

name: CriticalGK2.Automaton.headValue_nil
statement:
@[simp]
theorem headValue_nil (c : Coefficients R r d) (hd : 0 < d) (a b : Fin r) :
    headValue c hd [] a b = if a = b then 1 else 0

name: CriticalGK2.Automaton.letterTransition_head
statement:
@[simp]
theorem letterTransition_head (c : Coefficients R r d) (hd : 0 < d)
    (α : Bool) (a : Fin r) (t : State r d) :
    letterTransition c α (headState d hd a) t =
      Polynomial.monomial 1 (c a t.1 α t.2)

name: CriticalGK2.Automaton.letterTransition_internal_row
statement:
theorem letterTransition_internal_row (c : Coefficients R r d)
    (α β : Bool) (a : Fin r) (p : Residual d) (q : List Bool)
    (hp : p.val = β :: q) (t : State r d) :
    letterTransition c α (a, p) t =
      if β = α then if t = (a, tailResidual p) then 1 else 0 else 0

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.tensorCutRank_append_transport
statement:
theorem tensorCutRank_append_transport (e : Y ⊗[F] Z ≃ₗ[F] A)
    (t : X ⊗[F] Y) (z : Z) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
    tensorCutRank (e.lTensor X (TensorProduct.assoc F X Y Z (t ⊗ₜ[F] z))) =
      tensorCutRank t

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.tensorCutRank_prepend_transport
statement:
theorem tensorCutRank_prepend_transport (e : Z ⊗[F] X ≃ₗ[F] A)
    (z : Z) (hz : z ≠ 0) (t : X ⊗[F] Y) :
    tensorCutRank (e.rTensor Y ((TensorProduct.assoc F Z X Y).symm (z ⊗ₜ[F] t))) =
      tensorCutRank t

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.contractRight_leftEquiv
statement:
theorem contractRight_leftEquiv (e : X ≃ₗ[F] A) (t : X ⊗[F] Y)
    (eta : Module.Dual F Y) :
    contractRight eta (e.rTensor Y t) = e (contractRight eta t)

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.contractRight_prepend
statement:
theorem contractRight_prepend (x : X) (t : Y ⊗[F] Z) (eta : Module.Dual F Z) :
    contractRight eta ((TensorProduct.assoc F X Y Z).symm (x ⊗ₜ[F] t)) =
      x ⊗ₜ[F] contractRight eta t

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.extendedPair_leftEquiv
statement:
theorem extendedPair_leftEquiv (e : X ≃ₗ[F] A) (t : X ⊗[F] Y)
    (phi : Module.Dual F A) :
    extendedPair phi (e.rTensor Y t) = extendedPair (phi.comp e.toLinearMap) t

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.extendedPair_prepend
statement:
theorem extendedPair_prepend (x : X) (t : Y ⊗[F] Z)
    (eta : Module.Dual F (X ⊗[F] Y)) :
    extendedPair eta ((TensorProduct.assoc F X Y Z).symm (x ⊗ₜ[F] t)) =
      extendedPair (specializeLeft x eta) t

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.specializeLeft_apply
statement:
@[simp]
theorem specializeLeft_apply (x : X) (eta : Module.Dual F (X ⊗[F] Y)) (y : Y) :
    specializeLeft x eta y = eta (x ⊗ₜ[F] y)

name: CriticalGK2.ContractionBudget.tensorFrontProductSpace_leftEquiv_prefixSupport_finrank_le
statement:
theorem tensorFrontProductSpace_leftEquiv_prefixSupport_finrank_le
    [FiniteDimensional F X] [FiniteDimensional F Y] (e : X ⊗[F] Y ≃ₗ[F] A)
    (S : Submodule F X) (T : Submodule F (Y ⊗[F] Z)) :
    Module.finrank F (tensorPrefixSupport
      ((tensorFrontProductSpace S T).map (e.rTensor Z).toLinearMap)) ≤
      Module.finrank F S * Module.finrank F (tensorPrefixSupport T)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.unitizationBaseChange_scalar_tensor
statement:
theorem unitizationBaseChange_scalar_tensor (a : F) (c d : K) (z : A) :
    (c * d) ⊗ₜ[F] (a • z) = (a • c) • (d ⊗ₜ[F] z)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.unitizationScalarLinearEquiv_map_mul
statement:
theorem unitizationScalarLinearEquiv_map_mul
    (x y : (Unitization F A) ⊗[F] K) :
    unitizationScalarLinearEquiv F K A (x * y) =
      unitizationScalarLinearEquiv F K A x * unitizationScalarLinearEquiv F K A y

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.unitizationScalarLinearEquiv_tmul
statement:
@[simp]
theorem unitizationScalarLinearEquiv_tmul (u : Unitization F A) (c : K) :
    unitizationScalarLinearEquiv F K A (u ⊗ₜ[F] c) =
      Unitization.mk (u.fst • c, c ⊗ₜ[F] u.snd)

name: CriticalGK2.Actual.unitizationScalarLinearEquiv_tmul_mul
statement:
theorem unitizationScalarLinearEquiv_tmul_mul
    (u v : Unitization F A) (c d : K) :
    unitizationScalarLinearEquiv F K A ((u ⊗ₜ[F] c) * (v ⊗ₜ[F] d)) =
      unitizationScalarLinearEquiv F K A (u ⊗ₜ[F] c) *
        unitizationScalarLinearEquiv F K A (v ⊗ₜ[F] d)
